messages:
maya: :wave: Kicking off Polaris onboarding — quick sync thread. Goal is to get their first integration live in 30 days, surface any renewal risks early, and lock the enablement plan. I added high-level owners below. Can folks confirm availability and any immediate blockers?

sam: Happy to own the tech kickoff. Need model access + API keys from infra. @maya can you confirm Polaris has prod access or just sandbox?

maya: They have sandbox only today. We have approval for a dedicated trial cluster, pending PO. I'll follow up with account exec to confirm timeline.

nancy: PS here — I'll run the integration runbook and 1:1 enablement sessions. Proposed timeline: Week 1 discovery, Week 2 integration, Week 3 validation, Week 4 launch checklist + handoff. Does that align?

leo: From product: success criteria we care about — 1) end-to-end latency < 350ms p50 on typical queries, 2) 95% of core intents >= 90% accuracy on their eval set, 3) onboarding completed with <3 blocking issues. If they need custom reranking we'll flag timeline impact.

anna: Ops/enablement — I'll schedule two role-based sessions: Engineers (1.5h) and Product/PMs (1h). Also setting up change-logs and a feedback form for their power users. Proposed slots: Tue 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. Which works?

sam: Tue 10am PT works for me. Quick ask: do we have a template for the feedback form? I can adapt if you point me to it.

maya: Use the standard CS feedback template — I put a copy in the Polaris folder: https://drive.redwood/polaris/onboard (internal)

nancy: I'll prep an eval harness for their sample prompts. Can someone share sample traffic shape and typical sequence lengths? @sam?

sam: Attaching quick shape inlined here: 95% sequences < 128 tokens, bursty spikes around 250 tokens, typical payload ~ 900B. Also will add a small nginx proxy example for testing:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-mini","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood/v1/generate
```

maya: Nice. Ops note: renewal trigger is tied to their PO for the trial cluster. If PO slips >2 weeks we flag risk. I'll add a renewal-risk tag in our CRM and set a biweekly check-in cadence.

onboard-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: 
- sam -> tech kickoff & infra creds (due 3d)
- nancy -> integration runbook & eval harness (due 7d)
- anna -> schedule enablement sessions & feedback form (due 4d)
- maya -> confirm PO timeline with AE (due 2d)

leo: One more product ask — can we get an agreed-upon test prompt set by end of next week? That will let us baseline quality before launch.

maya: Agreed. @nancy can we include that in the Week 1 discovery deliverables?

nancy: Yep, will collect with the customer during discovery.

anna: I set the tentative Tue 10am slot and invite is out to the core list. I'll update if any conflicts.

sam: Received invite, added infra checklist to the calendar event notes.

maya: Thanks all. Quick recap in case anyone jumps in later:
- Timeline: 30d target with 4-week milestones
- Owners: sam (tech), nancy (PS), anna (enablement), maya (CS)
- Success metrics: latency, intent accuracy, <=3 blocking issues
- Renewal risk: PO delay >2w -> flag
- Next: tech kickoff (sam, 3d), discovery meeting (nancy, 1d)

leo: :thumbsup:

maya: I'll post a short status update every Monday in this thread. Please drop blockers here.

anna: :eyes: thanks, will capture feedback in the form and share results after session.

sam: Looks good. If PO comes in earlier we can move to dedicated trial ASAP.

onboard-bot: REMINDER: first action check-in scheduled in 3 days.

maya: End of thread — thanks team!
